skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id restart-prune --wait
job-id JOB
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
server stop
server start
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id restart-prune
stderr 'result expired'
await-usage JOBS 0
event-count 1
skygo --json jobs retention
! stdout 'private-task-value'
# Preserve a genuine outstanding output operation through actual daemon restarts.
# The private permission barrier prevents successful unlink before restoration.
[non-root] json-field admin.obligations.0.id OBLIGATION
[non-root] retention-usage CLEANUP_RECORDS 1
[non-root] output-permission deny
[non-root] skygo --json jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION --yes
[non-root] stdout '"marked": *1'
[non-root] skygo --json jobs retention
[non-root] stdout '"pending_cleanup_records": *"1"'
[non-root] retention-usage CLEANUP_RECORDS 2
[non-root] exists $DATA/logs/$JOB.log
server stop
! stderr .
[non-root] cleanup-checkpoint save $JOB pending.json
[non-root] server start
[non-root] skygo --json jobs retention
[non-root] stdout '"pending_cleanup_records": *"1"'
[non-root] retention-usage CLEANUP_RECORDS 2
[non-root] exists $DATA/logs/$JOB.log
[non-root] server stop
[non-root] cleanup-checkpoint same $JOB pending.json
[non-root] output-permission restore
[non-root] server start
[non-root] await-usage OUTPUT_BYTES 0
[non-root] ! exists $DATA/logs/$JOB.log
[non-root] skygo --json jobs retention
[non-root] ! stdout '"pending_cleanup_records"'
[non-root] stdout '"needs_manual": *true'
[non-root] ! stdout '"output_pending": *true'
[non-root] retention-usage CLEANUP_RECORDS 1
[non-root] event-count 1
[non-root] server stop
! stderr .
